name: Sister Aquinne
summary: In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne studies beneath the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. The novice acolyte serves in the Temple Gardens.

sections.title: Acolyte in Darnassus
sections.body: Sister Aquinne studies with the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. She is stationed in the Temple Gardens, beneath the Temple of the Moon, learning from the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest needed help, Aquinne sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.

faq.q: Where can Sister Aquinne be found?
faq.answer: Sister Aquinne can be found in the Temple Gardens of Darnassus, just outside the Temple of the Moon.
Sister Aquinne is a novice priestess of Elune, studying at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Little is known of her life before she entered the temple's service.

angles.text: As a priest, you can recognize Aquinne's devotion as she undertakes the foundational training required of acolytes serving the Temple of the Moon.
As a night elf arriving in Darnassus, you can meet Sister Aquinne in the Temple Gardens and see a first glimpse of the temple priesthood.
